cast.name: 安尼萨·达伍德 Anissa Daoud

introduction: The film's events take place in Tunisia in the 1930s, more precisely from 1924 to 1934. It tells the story of three Legends in Tunisian History: Tahar Haddad, an intellectual, trade unionist and politician who struggled for the Tunisians' human rights (in general). Mohamed Ali El Hammi, founder of the first Tunisian trade union movement and Abu El Kacem Chebbi, who is considered the reformer of Tunisian Poetry. In a very agitated political context, with people fight for independence from French Colonialism, the movie shows how these three men sought to reform and develop the Tunisian Society at that specific time.
